- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided simple recipes for energy balls and homemade granola bars.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Energy Balls Recipe: 
  - Ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup dried fruit, 1/2 cup nut butter, 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup, 1/4 cup chopped nuts, pinch of salt, optional flavorings.
  - Instructions: Combine ingredients, shape into balls, refrigerate.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Homemade Granola Bars Recipe: 
  - Ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup chopped nuts, 1 cup dried fruit, 1/2 cup nut butter, 1/4 cup honey or maple syrup, 1/4 cup brown sugar, pinch of salt, optional flavorings.
  - Instructions: Combine ingredients, press into a baking dish, bake, cool, and cut into bars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested variations for energy balls including coconut flakes, cinnamon, nutty crunch, dried cranberry orange, peanut butter banana, and chocolate chip.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adding grated Parmesan cheese to smoky popcorn for extra flavor.

- [PREFERENCE] User is considering using cashew milk or hazelnut milk in smoothies and oatmeal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided recipes for making cashew milk and hazelnut milk at home.
